<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 268.1939, which corresponds to the protonated molecule [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.0073 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 267.1867 Da. The observed isotopic pattern (≈ 20 % M+1) is consistent with a composition containing about 19 carbon atoms. The formula C₁₉H₂₃O matches this exact mass (267.1749 Da) within typical instrument error and reproduces the isotopic distribution, making it the most plausible molecular formula.</thought>
<final_answer>C19H23O</final_answer>
